supported_format: RFC 7946 GeoJSON, legacy-GeoJSON, G-AID custom import, or documented ESRI shapefile (.shp/.shx/.dbf with .prj EPSG)
notes: Verification used the Next.js workspace UI that Electron loads (same GridMapView).
A packaged Electron executable was not launched.
Kernel ingest uses vendored pyshp 2.3.1. Catalog inspect uses a matching ESRI spec reader. Sidecar names alone are not support.
Supported geometry: ESRI types 1/3/5/8 (Point, PolyLine, Polygon, MultiPoint flattened to Point/LineString/Polygon).
Z/M/MultiPatch, missing .shp/.shx/.dbf, corrupt DBF, invalid UTF-8 vs declared .cpg, missing/EPSG-less .prj stay recognised-unsupported.
geology.shp stayed generic-vector. UNIT/LITHOLOGY/filename do not establish geology.
CRS source shapefile-prj with high/medium confidence is shown. Coordinates were not reprojected.
Spatial overlap is a geometric table. It is not a prospectivity map.
Export writer is GeoJSON only (shapefile=false, geopackage=false) with source shapefile provenance retained.
GeoPackage remains recognised-unsupported. There is no Fiona/GDAL/pyogrio reader.

overlap.reason_includes: does not establish geological, mineral, or causal relationships
